title: Add tail-latency and backpressure sensors for VPC/private deployments
creator: Ayesha Kapoor
description: Introduce a focused set of runtime sensors and Prometheus probes for private (VPC) deployments that measure tail latency, request queue/backpressure, KV-cache miss ratio, per-replica token throughput, and saturation signals (GPU/CPU/mem). The goal is to make SLOs actionable for private customers by surfacing early saturation/backpressure before client-perceived errors increase, and by enabling automated routing/scale policies in Dedicated/Private orchestration. This ticket covers sensor definition, runtime instrumentation hooks, Terraform module wiring for probe endpoints, and dashboards/alerting runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Prometheus metrics emitted from private runtime agents: request_queue_length, request_backpressure_events, tail_latency_ms{p95,p99}, kv_cache_miss_rate, token_throughput_per_replica, gpu_utilization_percent
New Terraform module (modules/vpc-health-sensors) deploys a sidecar prometheus exporter and configures necessary TARGET_GROUP and SG rules in VPC stacks without manual edits
Grafana dashboard 'Private Deploy - Backpressure & Tail Latency' deployed to observability cluster with p95/p99 panels and saturation heatmap

Pager duty runbook added and alert thresholds defined: p99 latency > 2x baseline for 5m (SEV3), request_queue_length > configured burst limit for 2m (SEV2), token throughput drop > 30% sustained (SEV2)
Automated smoke test (terraform apply -> deploy canary -> inject load) validates sensors within CI pipeline and fails on missing metrics
work_log: 2026-02-23: Kickoff with runtime and infra. Decided to implement exporter as a lightweight sidecar in private runtime to avoid changing core binary. Marcus to prototype exporter + metrics schema.

2026-02-26: Prototype emits candidate metrics: request_queue_length, request_backpressure_count, latency_ms_summary. Observed inconsistent aggregation across replicas — need per-replica token throughput labeling.

2026-03-02: Design review with PM/Observability. Agreed p95/p99 for tail latency; token throughput metric to be tokens_generated_total / scrape_interval with replica and model labels. Acceptance thresholds drafted.
2026-03-05: Terraform module draft (modules/vpc-health-sensors) wired into test VPC stack. Required adding additional SG rule for exporter port and target group registration logic. Open PR infra#321.
2026-03-08: Discovered race in startup ordering: exporter comes up before runtime reports replica ID -> added label file handshake to ensure stable replica labeling. Added retry logic in exporter.

2026-03-11: Ran canary with 2k RPS burst test. request_queue_length spikes observed, backpressure events emitted and discriminator rules triggered as expected. Found KV cache miss_count high for >50% requests for one canary model — filing follow-up ENG-9340 for cache tuning.
